quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a fermented food subscription box featuring rare global probiotic products.

quests.hint: Lead with the global variety and gut health credentials together.
quests.explanation: Global variety combined with gut health science creates a premium subscription positioning in a growing market.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a speciality cheese delivery platform sourcing directly from European farmhouses.

quests.hint: Lead with the direct farmhouse sourcing and 48-hour freshness.
quests.explanation: Direct farmhouse sourcing and 48-hour delivery is a powerful freshness claim that differentiates premium cheese.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.hint: Lead with same-day freshness and the wild provenance.
quests.explanation: Same-day delivery of foraged ingredients is an extreme freshness story that no conventional supply chain can match.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.explanation: Teaching restaurant techniques rather than just delivering ingredients is a premium educational positioning.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an AI meal planner that reduces food waste by using expiring ingredients first.

quests.hint: Lead with the waste reduction mechanism.
quests.explanation: Waste reduction that saves money creates an economic incentive that reinforces the environmental benefit.

quests.hint: Lead with the complete end-to-end service.
quests.explanation: Complete end-to-end service - shopping cooking and cleaning - is the ultimate convenience pitch for dinner parties.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a restaurant table management system that eliminates no-shows using smart deposits.
quests.correctAnswer: Our system collects a small refundable deposit at booking and eliminates no-shows - restaurants fill every table and customers always get the seat they reserved.
quests.hint: Lead with the win-win for both restaurants and diners.
quests.explanation: Aligning restaurant and customer incentives through deposits is an elegant operational pitch.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a kitchen inventory management system for restaurant chains across multiple sites.
quests.correctAnswer: Our system tracks ingredient stock in real time across every kitchen location and automatically reorders before anything runs out - zero stock surprises.
quests.hint: Highlight the automatic stock prevention of running out.
quests.explanation: Automatic reordering before stock runs out prevents the service failures and food waste that manual systems cause.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a ghost kitchen management platform for delivery-only restaurant brands.
quests.correctAnswer: Our platform manages multiple delivery-only food brands from a single shared kitchen - maximising revenue per square metre in the most efficient model for food delivery.
quests.hint: Lead with the revenue maximisation from shared space.
quests.explanation: Revenue per square metre maximisation is the core financial case for any ghost kitchen investment.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.explanation: Provenance transparency to chefs differentiates premium ingredients and builds the brand stories restaurants need to tell.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.

quests.explanation: Specific examples of well-known food fraud make the problem immediately credible and personally relevant.
